package.name: deep_bridge
package.description: Bridges geometry_msgs/Twist cmd_vel to Deep Robotics Lynx M20's UDP/JSON body-monitoring protocol (axis-command ASDU, Type=2 Command=21), with a safety watchdog that stops the robot when cmd_vel stops arriving or the robot's own status reports (hard e-stop, usage mode, motion state) say it isn't safe to drive. The protocol is plain UDP with a 16-byte header + JSON ASDU body, so this package implements the framing itself (see include/deep_bridge/UdpProtocol.h) instead of depending on a vendor SDK. JSON parsing uses a vendored single-header nlohmann/json (include/deep_bridge/json.hpp, MIT licensed) rather than adding a system package dependency.
